arxiv-2012-09856.title: Reconstructing Hand-Object Interactions in the Wild
arxiv-2012-09856.creator: Zhe Cao, Ilija RadosavovicAngjoo KanazawaJitendra Malik[2mm] University of California, Berkeley
arxiv-2012-09856.description: Abstract We study the problem of understanding hand-object interactions from 2D images in the wild. This requires reconstructing both the hand and the object in 3D, which is challenging because of the mutual occlusion between the hand and the object.

arxiv-2205-05465.title: A Compactness Theorem for functions on Poisson point clouds
arxiv-2205-05465.creator: Marco Caroccia
arxiv-2205-05465.description: Abstract . In this work we show a compactness Theorem for discrete functions on Poisson point clouds. We consider sequences with equibounded non-local p p -Dirichlet energy: the novelty consists in the intermediate-interaction regime at which the non-local energy is computed. 1.

arxiv-2205-08390.title: HoVer-Trans: Anatomy-aware HoVer-Transformer for ROI-free Breast Cancer Diagnosis in Ultrasound Images
arxiv-2205-08390.creator: Yuhao Mo, Chu Han, Yu Liu, Min Liu, Zhenwei Shi, Jiatai Lin, Bingchao Zhao, Chunwang Huang, Bingjiang Qiu, Yanfen Cui, Lei Wu, Xipeng Pan, Zeyan Xu, Xiaomei Huang, Zaiyi Liu, Ying Wang, Changhong Liang
arxiv-2205-08390.description: Abstract Ultrasonography is an important routine examination for breast cancer diagnosis, due to its non-invasive, radiation-free and low-cost properties. However, the diagnostic accuracy of breast cancer is still limited due to its inherent limitations. It would be a tremendous success if we can precisely diagnose breast cancer by breast ultrasound images (BUS).

arxiv-2208-04636.title: Magnetic properties of moiré quantum dot arrays
arxiv-2208-04636.creator: Weronika Pasek, Michal Kupczynski, Pawel Potasz
arxiv-2208-04636.description: Abstract We investigate magnetic properties of quantum dot arrays of moiré triangular superlattices. Starting from a reciprocal space model, we use the projection technique to obtain maximally localized Wannier functions and determine generalized Hubbard model parameters. The many-body Hamiltonian is solved using the exact diagonalization method as a function of the number of electrons in differently shaped quantum dots arrays.

arxiv-2401-16782.title: A Literature Review on Fetus Brain Motion Correction in MRI
arxiv-2401-16782.creator: Haoran Zhang 1, Yun Wang 2
arxiv-2401-16782.description: Abstract \footertext 1 Introduction Observing fetal brain development is crucial for diagnosing conditions such as autism and other developmental anomalies [ 1 ] . Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) offers significant advantages in this context, being precise, rapid, and exhibiting no known harmful effects in either the short or long term when examining brain development [ 2 ] .

arxiv-2403-02947.title: Phase Behavior and Dynamics of Active Brownian Particles in an Alignment Field
arxiv-2403-02947.creator: Sameh Othman, Jiarul Midya, Thorsten Auth, Gerhard Gompper
arxiv-2403-02947.description: Abstract Self-propelled particles that are subject to noise are a well-established generic model system for active matter. A homogeneous alignment field can be used to orient the direction of the self-propulsion velocity and to model systems like phoretic Janus particles with a magnetic dipole moment or magnetotactic bacteria in an external magnetic field.

arxiv-2412-06417.title: Systematic comparison of deep generative models applied to multivariate financial time series.
arxiv-2412-06417.creator: Howard Caulfield, James P. Gleeson
arxiv-2412-06417.description: Abstract . Financial time series (FTS) generation models are a core pillar to applications in finance. Risk management and portfolio optimization rely on realistic multivariate price generation models. Accordingly, there is a strong modelling literature dating back to Bachelier’s Theory of Speculation in 1901 ( Bachelier, 1901 ) .

arxiv-2502-21140.title: Modulation signals of solar reflected dark matter in crystal-based detectors
arxiv-2502-21140.creator: Haipeng An, Haoming Nie
arxiv-2502-21140.description: Abstract The scattering of light dark matter (DM) off thermal electrons within the Sun generates a “fast” sub-component of the DM flux that can be detected in underground direct detection experiments. This ”fast” sub-component has a specific origin—namely, from the Sun.

arxiv-2504-15206.title: How Global Calibration Strengthens Multiaccuracy
arxiv-2504-15206.creator: Sílvia Casacuberta, Parikshit Gopalan, Varun Kanade, Omer Reingold
arxiv-2504-15206.description: Abstract Multiaccuracy and multicalibration are multigroup fairness notions for prediction that have found numerous applications in learning and computational complexity [ 24 ] . They can be achieved from a single learning primitive: weak agnostic learning. A line of work starting from [ 17 ] has shown that multicalibration implies a very strong form of learning.

arxiv-2504-20857.creator: Andreea A. Vărăşteanu, Matt J. Jarvis, Anastasia A. Ponomareva, Harry Desmond, Ian Heywood, Tariq Yasin, Natasha Maddox, Marcin Glowacki, Michalina Maksymowicz-Maciata, Pavel E. Mancera Pi n ~ \mathrm{\tilde{n}} a, Hengxing Pan

arxiv-2506-15828.title: Context Matters! Relaxing Goals with LLMs for Feasible 3D Scene Planning
arxiv-2506-15828.creator: Emanuele Musumeci, Michele Brienza, Francesco Argenziano, Vincenzo Suriani, Daniele Nardi, Domenico D. Bloisi
arxiv-2506-15828.description: Abstract Classical planning in AI and Robotics addresses complex tasks by shifting from imperative to declarative approaches (e.g., PDDL). However, these methods often fail in real scenarios due to limited robot perception and the need to ground perceptions to planning predicates.

arxiv-2510-25224.title: ProMediate: A Socio-cognitive framework for evaluating proactive agents in multi-party negotiation
arxiv-2510-25224.creator: Ziyi Liu Bahar Sarrafzadeh Pei Zhou Longqi Yang Jieyu Zhao Ashish Sharma
arxiv-2510-25224.description: Abstract While Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in agentic frameworks to assist individual users, there is a growing need for agents that can proactively manage complex, multi-party collaboration. Systematic evaluation methods for such proactive agents remain scarce, limiting progress in developing AI that can effectively support multiple people together.

pmc-10566260.title: A case of ventricular triple rupture after an acute myocardial infarction
pmc-10566260.creator: Shotaro Kaneko, Shinichi Suzuki, Motohiko Goda, Daisuke Machida, Munetaka Masuda
pmc-10566260.description: Cardiac rupture, such as ventricular free-wall rupture, ventricular septal perforation, and papillary muscle rupture, is a life-threatening complication of acute myocardial infarction. Herein, we report a very rare case of combining these three types of ventricular rupture. A 71-year-old woman underwent mitral valve replacement and left ventricular free-wall rupture repair after an acute myocardial infarction.

pmc-11001342.title: Sodium butyrate improves mitochondrial function and kidney tissue injury in diabetic kidney disease via the AMPK/PGC-1α pathway
pmc-11001342.creator: Yue Yu, Yuan-Yuan Jia, Hong-Jun Li
pmc-11001342.description: PurposeInvestigate the mechanism of how sodium butyrate (NaBut) improves mitochondrial function and kidney tissue injury in diabetic kidney disease (DKD) via the AMPK/PGC-1α pathway.MethodsAssess the effects of NaBut on glucose and insulin tolerance, urine, and gut microbial composition in db/db and db/m mice.

pmc-11371771.title: Potential mechanisms of traditional Chinese medicine in the treatment of liver cirrhosis: a focus on gut microbiota
pmc-11371771.creator: Siyuan Sun, Guangheng Zhang, Shimeng Lv, Jinhui Sun
pmc-11371771.description: Cirrhosis, a pathological stage that develops from various chronic liver diseases, is characterized by liver fibrosis, pseudolobular formation, and chronic inflammation. When it progresses to the decompensated phase, the mortality rate of cirrhosis can reach 80%. The role of gut microbiota in the progression of liver diseases has received significant attention.

pmc-11556248.title: Advancing readiness for change in substance use for people with substance use disorders using the Kawa model based intervention program: A quasi-experimental study
pmc-11556248.creator: Han-Yi Hsiao, Tsui-Ying Wang, Chun-Hung Lee, Young-Chin Lu, Yu-Chen Huang, Ying-Chun Chien, Marc N Potenza, Chung-Ying Lin
pmc-11556248.description: BackgroundSubstance use disorders (SUDs) may cause severe social and health problems. Therefore, providing adequate treatments for people with SUDs to change their drug use behaviors is important. This study examined the effectiveness of Kawa Model based therapy among people with SUDs in Taiwan.

pmc-12663527.creator: Wenxin Yu, Jing Xue, Zehua Yang, Xiaoxin Xie, Yi Feng, Yu Zeng
pmc-12663527.description: Due to modern lifestyles and dietary changes, the prevalence of constipation is rising and affecting younger populations. uslaw-usc-t10-s7536.title: 10 U.S.C. § 7536 — Equipment: post bakeries, schools, kitchens, and mess halls
uslaw-usc-t10-s7536.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s7536.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part IV (Service, Supply, And Procurement); Chapter 763 (Procurement). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Money necessary for the following items for the use of enlisted members of the Army may be spent from appropriations for regular supplies: (1) Equipment for post bakeries. (2) Furniture, textbooks, paper, and equipment for post schools. (3) Tableware and mess.
